items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 64:1
items.html: The male of the second pair is the Bina of the stature of Bina, as above in Answer 114, for the second pair is considered, as a whole, to be of the aspect of a Nukva to the first pair. Hence the male of the first pair took the Hochma of MA, who is a true male; and even the Nukva of the first pair is likewise male, for she is the Zeir Anpin of Hochma, who is male, except that, being BON, needing correction from MA, she is therefore termed female. But in the second pair, even the male among them is found to be female, for it is the Bina of the stature of Bina, which is female, except that it is called male because it is from the name MA, which bestows and corrects the BON, and is therefore called by the name male. And the Nukva of the second pair is the lower half of the Bina of the Nekudim that remained after the first four of it were taken by Atik, as above in Answer 106, apart from the Malchut within it, which was taken by the Nukva of the fourth pair, as we shall write below. (Inner Light, Item 626, Sub Header, “And It Is Long”, and Item 654, Sub Header, “And It Is Necessary”)
